data.summary_en: We propose an agentic self-awareness framework: feasible/blocked paired tasks on Terminal-Bench 2.1 and retail τ²-bench; M0-M3 separates blockage recognition from correct-reason delay, aligning feasibility judgments, behavior, reconsideration. Terminal-Bench baseline: 84.4% blockage recognition, 40.6% strict SA; weight-update-free harness search raises strict SA 45.3%→93.8% on reused tasks.
